capabilities: Import papers from Zotero into structured literature notes
Sync Zotero PDF highlights and comments into a note with printed page numbers
Promote checked candidates into permanent notes from a template
Color syllabus literature-note links by progress and package a week's notes into a zip
Create and maintain synthesis notes listing unused permanent notes per topic
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); the plugin downloads the pdfannots2json utility from GitHub releases, checksum-verified, unless a custom path is set. It states it makes no other network connections and collects no usage data. Free and open source under GPL-3.0; separate setup and updating guides (STUDENT-SETUP-GUIDE.md, UPDATING.md) are referenced but not included in the README. BRAT install instructions are given until it appears in the community directory.
intentEvidence: 2.x copies the import formats and other settings from the community Zotero Integration plugin (obsidian-zotero-desktop-connector)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a paper's metadata and PDF annotations from Zotero into a structured literature note and keep them up to date while writing.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to Zotero's Better BibTeX plugin at (port 23119 for Zotero, 24119 for Juris-M
Commands are renamed from "Zotero Integration: …" to "Second Reader: …".
Highlight sync and PDF import use pdfannots2json, a program by mgmeyers that reads annotations out of PDF files.

requires.name: Zotero 7 desktop with the Better BibTeX plugin and "Allow other applications to communicate with Zotero" enabled
Tesseract (for the optional Image OCR setting)

summary: Literature-note workflow plugin that imports papers from Zotero, syncs PDF highlights into notes, and promotes candidates into permanent notes.
